text: Does your breathing become difficult or noisy (wheezy) during or after exercise?
Do you wake up at night due to cough or breathing difficulty?
Are you experiencing sudden severe difficulty breathing right now?
Do you have a persistent cough that produces phlegm most days?
Have you smoked cigarettes for more than 10 pack-years?
Do you have a fever along with your cough?
Are you breathing very fast or does your oxygen feel low?
Have you had a cough lasting more than 3 weeks?
Have you had unexplained weight loss in the past few months?
Have you ever smoked or been exposed to asbestos/industrial dust?
Do you feel chest pain that is worse when breathing in deeply?
Do you cough up large amounts of phlegm in the mornings?
